NEVORA v5 · One look

Every role on the approved Quiet base, so signing in and moving between Owner, Manager, Lead and Employee feels like one product. 26 phone screens with fictional people and data. Approve these and they are built exactly, as with v4.

Decisions for you

  • Owner dark modeToday the Owner and Manager app stays light even when the phone is dark. These mockups propose it follows the phone like everyone else (last screen).
  • Delete account layoutThe legal sentences are unchanged, but they are regrouped into rows and the long retention list opens from “What may be kept”. Needs your OK because it is account-deletion wording.
  • More becomes a pageFor employees, More opens a page (like the Owner’s) instead of a pop-up sheet.
  • Shift changes as sheetsSwap, offer for cover and Unable to work start from a shift and open as sheets; the separate pages go away.

Employee: the everyday screens

One white page, 34pt titles, grouped rows and one teal, like the Owner app. Round 2: a warmer Home, the company name only on Home, counts on the right of section titles, and small teal icons where something needs you.

Changing a shift: bottom sheets

Tapping a shift opens a sheet over the schedule. Swap and Unable to work are sheets, so there is no separate page and no false error.

Requests, time and updates

Segments replace the tab strip that scrolled off the screen; zero counts are hidden.

Profile and Delete account

Delete account keeps every sentence, regrouped as three rows with icons. Asking a second time is a switch, and the red button only wakes when it is on.

Lead and Manager

A Lead sees the same app with a team section and can message today’s team. A Manager without access gets one calm page.

Dark mode, every role

True black, lifted greys, one lifted teal for text and the active tab. The teal button keeps white text, and a selected segment sits lighter than its track. Sign-in follows the phone too.

Built from the v4 kit (kit4.css) plus the v5 additions: the Home card, sheets, radio rows and dark tokens. Phosphor icons only; type scale 34 · 20 · 17 · 15 · 13 · 11.
